Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a fundamental logical error in interpreting the definition of "tame" versus "wild" animals. It incorrectly selected option D ("Staying away from people") as the behavior of tame animals, whereas tame animals are defined by their lack of fear of humans and their tendency to approach them. The correct distinguishing behavior is option B ("Eating out of the hands of humans"). The error stems from a misinterpretation of the core concept (confusing the behavior of wild animals with that of tame ones) and a failure to verify this basic biological fact before declaring the task complete.
